notes.value: Dongfeng 007, an electric fastback sedan, sold by Chawla Green Motors in three trims (PakNEV). Essence, the headline here: 58.4 kWh battery, 160 kW (215 hp) rear motor, 310 Nm, rear-wheel drive, 0–100 km/h 6.8 s, 550 km CLTC, DC 100 kW, PKR 11,900,000. Prestige: 73.5 kWh, 268 hp, 320 Nm, RWD, 5.8 s, 650 km CLTC, DC 120 kW, PKR 12,990,000. Excellence: 73.5 kWh, dual motors with 536 hp and 640 Nm, AWD, 3.5 s, 565 km CLTC, DC 120 kW, PKR 13,900,000. All: 180 km/h, AC 11 kW, DC 10–80% in about 26 min, CCS2 and Type 2. 4,880 × 1,895 × 1,460 mm on a 2,915 mm wheelbase, 163 mm ground clearance, 452 L boot, 1,767–1,970 kg, 5 seats. PakNEV estimates 386–456 km in real-world use. Warranty: vehicle 5 years / 150,000 km and battery 8 years / 200,000 km per the PakWheels launch report (PakNEV lists the battery at 6 years / 150,000 km), so confirm with the dealer. Sources: PakNEV, PakWheels.

notes.value: Dongfeng Box, a compact electric hatchback, sold by Chawla Green Motors. Smart 330, the headline here: 32.56 kWh LFP battery, 330 km CLTC, 3.3 kW AC (about 10.5 hours), PKR 5,500,000. The 430 trims have a 42.3 kWh battery, 430 km CLTC (about 302 km real-world per PakNEV), 6.6 kW AC and 60 kW DC (10–80% in about 30 minutes): Lux Basic PKR 6,400,000, Lux Limited 6,488,000, Flagship 6,800,000, Flagship Premium 6,875,000. All: 70 kW (94 hp) front motor, 160 Nm, 0–100 km/h 12.5 s, 140 km/h, CCS2 and Type 2. 4,020–4,030 × 1,810 × 1,570 mm on a 2,660 mm wheelbase, 160 mm ground clearance, 326 L boot, 5 seats. Equipment ranges from dual airbags, ESC, a 12.8-inch screen and keyless start on the base car to a Level 2 ADAS suite, 540° camera, auto parking, heated and ventilated driver's seat and 17-inch alloys on the Flagship. Warranty: vehicle 4 years / 150,000 km, battery 8 years / 200,000 km. Sources: PakNEV, Gari.pk, Profit.

notes.value: Dongfeng Vigo (sold globally as the Nammi 06), a compact electric SUV, by Chawla Green Motors in four trims (PakNEV): E1 Dynamic PKR 6,999,000, E2 7,499,000 and E2 Premium 7,850,000 with a 44.94 kWh LFP battery, and E2 Plus PKR 8,800,000 with 51.87 kWh. 120 kW (161 hp) front motor, 230 Nm, 0–100 km/h 8.2 s, 150 km/h. Range 353 km WLTP for the 44.94 kWh car (430 km on the looser CLTC cycle; the E2 Plus 471 km CLTC); PakNEV estimates 302–331 km in real-world use. AC 6.6 kW, DC 60 kW (10–80% in about 30 minutes on the 44.94 kWh car), CCS2. 4,306 × 1,868 × 1,654 mm on a 2,715 mm wheelbase, 190 mm ground clearance, 500 L boot, 1,450–1,490 kg, 5 seats. The E1 Dynamic has 4 airbags, a reversing camera, 12.8-inch screen and keyless start; the E2 trims add 6 airbags, Level 2 ADAS, a 540° camera, V2L, heated and ventilated powered front seats, a panoramic sunroof and LED headlights. Warranty: vehicle 5 years / 150,000 km, battery 8 years / 200,000 km. Sources: PakNEV, PakWheels, Gari.pk.

notes.value: Forthing Friday BEV, the all-electric version of Dongfeng Forthing's Friday SUV, sold by Capital Smart Motors. Per the Capital Smart Motors brochure: 64.4 kWh LFP battery, front permanent-magnet motor with 150 kW and 340 Nm, front-wheel drive, 500 km CLTC; AC Type 2 in about 7 hours (0–100%) and DC CCS2 30–80% in 30 minutes, with a 3.3 kW portable charger and a camping mode. 0–100 km/h about 8 s and 170 km/h per PakNEV, which estimates about 351 km in real-world use. 4,600 × 1,860 × 1,680 mm on a 2,715 mm wheelbase, 180 mm ground clearance, 480 L boot, 1,820 kg, 19-inch wheels on 235/55 R19 with a full-size spare, 500 mm wading depth, McPherson front and multi-link rear suspension. Two trims: BEV Luxury PKR 8,999,000 and BEV Exclusive PKR 10,499,000; the Exclusive adds the driver-assistance suite, 360° camera and premium materials. Warranty: vehicle 5 years / 150,000 km, battery 8 years / 160,000 km (PakWheels; PakNEV lists 5 years / 100,000 km and 8 years / 120,000 km, so confirm with the dealer). Sources: Capital Smart Motors brochure, PakNEV, PakWheels.

notes.value: Forthing Friday REEV, the range-extended version of Dongfeng Forthing's Friday SUV, sold by Capital Smart Motors: a 1.5-litre (1,498 cc) petrol engine only generates electricity, and the wheels are driven by the electric motor. Per the Capital Smart Motors brochure: 31.94 kWh LFP battery, rear permanent-magnet motor with 120 kW and 240 Nm, rear-wheel drive, about 220 km electric and about 1,150 km combined (CLTC) from a 43 L tank; AC Type 2 in about 5.5 hours and DC CCS2 30–80% in 30 minutes (40 kW per PakNEV), 3.3 kW portable charger, camping mode. 0–100 km/h 10.9 s, 170 km/h. 4,600 × 1,860 × 1,680 mm on a 2,715 mm wheelbase, 180 mm ground clearance, 480 L boot, 1,820 kg, 19-inch wheels on 235/55 R19 with a full-size spare. Equipment includes 6 airbags, a 360° camera, adaptive cruise control, AEB, lane keeping, LED matrix headlights, dual HD screens, dual-zone climate control, wireless charging and an electric panoramic sunroof. PKR 9,999,000 (REEV Exclusive). Warranty: vehicle 5 years / 150,000 km, battery 8 years / 160,000 km (PakWheels; PakNEV lists the battery at 8 years / 120,000 km). PakNEV lists this car as front-wheel drive with 204 hp, which are the BEV's figures; the brochure is followed here. Sources: Capital Smart Motors brochure, PakNEV, PakWheels.
